proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8265 putra explicitly gives put/puttar/pūt and northern pūc̣/pūṣ, alongside Palula putr and the wider son family. Punjabi-mediated puttar is explicitly allowed by the addendum; a bare pū requires separate local contraction evidence. Uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages does not prevent this supported family link under the user’s preference.
